name: Value Proposition of the AWS Cloud
generalExplanation: The value proposition of the AWS Cloud includes shifting from large upfront infrastructure investment to usage-based costs, much faster resource provisioning, less work managing data centers, the ability to adjust capacity to demand, and the ability to expand workloads globally. The primary value goes beyond having servers in the cloud, by improving agility, reducing wasted capacity, and allowing teams to focus on business needs.
keyNote: AWS Cloud provides agility and cost flexibility: use resources on demand, pay for what you use, and reduce the work of managing physical infrastructure.

name: Economies of Scale
generalExplanation: Economies of scale occurs because AWS combines usage from many customer and operates infrastructure within scale very large. Scale that can reduce cost per unit and diterjemahkan to cost variable that lower for customer compared with if each organization builds capacity similar itself. Economies of scale different from elasticity: economies of scale relates with efficiency cost because scale provider, whereas elasticity relates with adds or reduces capacity follows demand.
keyNote: Economies of scale = scale large AWS helps reduces cost per unit; elasticity = capacity changes follows demand.

name: Elasticity
generalExplanation: Elasticity is capability adds capacity when demand naik and reduces capacity when demand decreases so that resource more according to requirements actual. Elasticity helps avoids overprovisioning for peak demand throughout time. This different from scalability, namely capability workload grows to handle load that larger, and different from high availability, that focuses on maintains service remains available when a failure occurs failure.
keyNote: Elasticity = capacity naik and decreases follows demand; scalability = capability grows; high availability = remains available during a failure.

name: High Availability and Fault Tolerance
generalExplanation: High availability focuses on maintains workload remains available when a failure occurs failure with reduces single point of failure, uses redundancy, and performs failover to resource that healthy. In AWS, runs workload on several Availability Zone is pattern general to restrict impact failure one location. Fault-tolerant design uses redundancy and fault isolation so that workload can continually operates when component fails. High availability different from elasticity that adjusts capacity against demand. Backup helps recovery data, but backup only not creates application remains serves request when component active fails.
keyNote: High availability and fault tolerance relies on redundancy/fault isolation; Multi-AZ helps prevents one location becomes single point of failure.

name: AWS Well-Architected Framework
generalExplanation: AWS Well-Architected Framework provides approach that consistent to evaluate workload against best practices and finds area that need improvement. This framework has six pillar: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability. Trade-off across pillar determined by context business, but Security and Operational Excellence generally not traded off against other pillar. This framework is not service that automatically changes resource rather than certificate compliance.
keyNote: Well-Architected = evaluation workload against best practices through six pillar and use hasilnya for determines improvement.

name: Shared Responsibility Model
generalExplanation: AWS Shared Responsibility Model divides responsibility into security OF the cloud and security IN the cloud. AWS protects physical facilities, hardware, networking, and infrastructure that runs AWS services. Customer remains is responsible for data, identity and access, and configuration controlled by the customer. The extent of operational responsibility depends on service: with Amazon EC2 customer manages guest OS, patching, application, and security group; on managed services such as Amazon RDS AWS handles more layers underlying including operating system; on AWS Lambda AWS manages server and operating system temporary the customer secures code, data, and permissions; on Amazon S3 customer manages data and bucket/access configuration.
keyNote: AWS = security OF the cloud; customer = security IN the cloud, and division duties changes according to the level of managed service.

name: Well-Architected: Operational Excellence
generalExplanation: Operational Excellence is capability supports development and runs workload effectively, gets insight about operation, and continually improves process for produces business value. In practice includes observability, procedure that clear, changes small that can dibalik, pembelajaran from kejadian operational, and automation to reduce human error. Pilar this different from Reliability: Operational Excellence focuses on way teams operates and increases workload, whereas Reliability focuses on workload that remains runs function that diharapkan and recovers from disruption.
keyNote: Operational Excellence = operation that measurable, can repeated, can dipelajari, and continually improved.

name: Well-Architected: Security
generalExplanation: Security pillar focuses on protection data, system, and asset while leverages cloud technology to improve security posture. Area its importance includes identity and access management, traceability, protection data, security in various layer, automation, and persiapan faces security events. Security is more than just creates system remains available; Availability and recovery closer with Reliability.
keyNote: Security = protect data, system, and asset with control identity, protection layered, traceability, and response that ready.

name: Well-Architected: Reliability
generalExplanation: Reliability is capability workload runs function that intended in a manner correct and consistent when required. This includes fondasi that strong, architecture that resilient, management changes that consistent, capability obtains resource to meet demand, and process recovery that has tested. Reliability different from Performance Efficiency, that menekankan resource usage in a manner efficient to meet requirement performance.
keyNote: Reliability = workload remains functions appropriate harapan and mampu recovers from disruption.

name: Well-Architected: Performance Efficiency
generalExplanation: Performance Efficiency is capability uses computing resources in a manner efficient to meet requirement system and maintains efficiency when demand or technology changes. In practice meliputi selection resource that appropriate, measurement performance, experiment, and pemanfaatan service or technology that appropriate. Pilar this does not the same as Cost Optimization: solution cheapest does not necessarily meets requirements performance, and solution tercepat does not necessarily most economical cost.
keyNote: Performance Efficiency = use resource and technology that appropriate to meet requirements performance in a manner efficient.

name: Well-Architected: Cost Optimization
generalExplanation: Cost Optimization is capability runs system to provide business value on price point lowest that as needed. Its focus includes Cloud Financial Management, understands expenditure and usage, selects resource that cost-effective, adjusts supply with demand, and optimizes workload in a manner continuous. Cost Optimization does not mean always selects resource cheapest if choice that fails meets requirement business.
keyNote: Cost Optimization = hilangkan waste and choose pattern usage that gives business value at a cost of that appropriate.

name: Well-Architected: Sustainability
generalExplanation: Sustainability pillar focuses on reduction environmental impact workload cloud through improvement efficiency and reduction waste. In practice includes menyelaraskan resource with demand, increases utilization, uses hardware and service that efficient, optimizes software and data, and considers location workload if requirement business enables. Cost Optimization and Sustainability often both reduces waste, but Sustainability focuses on environmental impact whereas Cost Optimization focuses on business value and cost.
keyNote: Sustainability = reduce environmental impact with maximizes efficiency and minimizes resource that is not required.

name: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)
generalExplanation: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) helps organization accelerates business outcomes with assesses cloud readiness, identifies capability gaps, and mengembangkan transformation roadmap in a manner iteratif. AWS CAF has six perspectives: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, and Operations. AWS CAF focuses on readiness and transformation organization, whereas AWS Well-Architected Framework focuses on evaluation workload against architectural best practices.
keyNote: AWS CAF = framework transformation organization with six perspectives: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, Operations.

name: Migration Strategies (7 Rs)
generalExplanation: AWS uses seven general strategies for determines approach migration application: rehost, relocate, replatform, refactor/re-architect, repurchase, retain, and retire. Rehost moves workload with changes minimum; replatform performs optimization limited without redesign large; refactor changes architecture in a manner more in-depth; repurchase moves to other product such as SaaS; retain delays or maintains workload in environment source; retire stops workload that not again required; relocate moves workload without changes architecture in a manner overall, for example moves platform that compatible.
keyNote: 7 Rs = Rehost, Relocate, Replatform, Refactor, Repurchase, Retain, Retire.

name: Migration Services (AWS Transform MGN, Application Discovery Service, Migration Hub, Migration Evaluator)
generalExplanation: AWS provides tools for stage migration that different. AWS Transform MGN, that previously named AWS Application Migration Service, used to rehost server to AWS with replication and cutover. AWS Application Discovery Service collects configuration, utilization, process, and dependency data to help migration planning. AWS Migration Hub provides place centralized to view and tracks migration information. Migration Evaluator helps assessment and directional business case with data inventory and utilization. Service this different from AWS DMS/SCT that focuses on database migration. AWS Application Discovery Service and AWS Migration Hub not receives customer new since 7 November 2025; customer that already uses service that can continues appropriate provisions AWS. AWS merekomendasikan AWS Transform for requirements new. Name/function service long remains dipelajari because still called within list service CLF-C02 that reviewed.
keyNote: MGN = rehost server; Discovery Service = discovery; Migration Hub = tracking; Migration Evaluator = assessment/business case.

name: Fixed vs Variable Costs
generalExplanation: One of economic benefit cloud is exchanges a large upfront fixed expense with variable expense that follows usage. On model tradisional, organization often buys data center and hardware before knows demand actual. In AWS, many resource can dikonsumsi with model usage-based so that cost more easy follows requirements. Fixed vs variable cost different from economies of scale: fixed/variable discusses model expenditure customer, whereas economies of scale discusses efficiency cost because AWS operates within scale large.
keyNote: Cloud helps exchanges upfront fixed expense with variable expense that follows usage.

name: Licensing Strategies (BYOL vs License Included, License Manager)
generalExplanation: Software in AWS can use model Bring Your Own License (BYOL) when terms vendor allows customer uses license that already owned, or model license-included when cost license already including within usage product or resource. AWS License Manager helps organization manages self-managed licenses, tracks usage, applies licensing rules, and increases visibility and compliance in various account and Region. Choice licensing remains must follow terms from software vendor.
keyNote: BYOL uses entitlement milik customer; license-included includes license; License Manager helps tracking and compliance.

name: Rightsizing (AWS Compute Optimizer)
generalExplanation: Rightsizing is process matches configuration and size resource with requirements workload so that not overprovisioned or underprovisioned. AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes configuration and utilization metrics to provide recommendation that can help increases performance, saves cost, or both. Rightsizing different from elasticity: rightsizing selects size/configuration that appropriate, whereas elasticity adds or reduces capacity follows changes demand.
keyNote: Rightsizing = cocokkan size resource with requirements; Compute Optimizer gives recommendation based on utilization.

name: Benefits of Automation
generalExplanation: Automation creates operation and changes more repeatable, consistent, fast, and fewer depends on step manual that rawan human error. In AWS, infrastructure and operations can defined as code, then tested, di-version-control, and run automatically. AWS CloudFormation is example service for provisioning infrastructure in a manner repeatable from template. Automation different from elasticity: automation is way executes process consistently, whereas elasticity is changes capacity follows demand.
keyNote: Automation = process repeatable and consistent, reduces manual effort and human error.

name: IAM Users, Groups, and Policies
generalExplanation: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls authentication and authorization for AWS resources. IAM user is identity with credentials long-term for use case specific, whereas IAM group is kumpulan IAM users that can receive permissions shared. IAM policies is JSON documents that determines allowed or denied actions, resources, and conditions. Apply least privilege: provide only permissions that is required. AWS managed policies managed by AWS and can be used again, whereas customer managed policies created and managed customer for requirements specific. Credential reports and access information such as last-used data helps reviews credentials and permissions.
keyNote: IAM policies determines permissions; use least privilege and review credentials/access periodically.

name: IAM Roles
generalExplanation: IAM role is AWS identity with permissions but without standard long-term credentials such as password or access keys. User, application, or AWS service can assume role and receives temporary security credentials. Roles general used to grant AWS services access to resources, federation, and cross-account access. For cross-account role, trust policy on role determines principal that may assume role, whereas permissions policy determines what that can performed after role di-assume.
keyNote: IAM role = permissions + temporary credentials; trust policy determines who that may assume role.

name: AWS Account Root User
generalExplanation: AWS account root user created shared account and is identity very privileged for services, resources, and billing within account, with limitations that remains can applies appropriate context organization. AWS merekomendasikan so that root user not used for work sehari-hari and only used for task that indeed requires root credentials. Root user must diamankan with MFA and recovery mechanisms that strong; do not create long-term access keys for root user. For administration daily use workforce access through IAM Identity Center or identity/role that appropriate. Access root does not mean without all limitations: SCP can restrict root user on member AWS account Organizations. This does not change principle that root must protected and does not used for work routine.
keyNote: Root user very privileged: do not use for daily administration, enable MFA, and avoid root access keys.

name: MFA, Password Policies, and Access Keys
generalExplanation: Credential security reduces risk account compromise. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) adds factor both besides password and very important for privileged access. IAM password policy manages requirements password for IAM users that uses console password. Access keys used for programmatic access and is long-term credentials, so that should avoided when temporary credentials through roles or federation available, not di-hard-code, diproteksi, and dirotasi/disabled when is not required.
keyNote: Use MFA and temporary credentials if enables; protect and minimalkan long-term access keys.

name: AWS IAM Identity Center
generalExplanation: AWS IAM Identity Center is solution AWS to connect workforce users to AWS accounts and applications. Identity Center can use directory built-in or connected to external identity provider and provides centralized assignment through permission sets for access to many AWS accounts. Its focus is workforce access and federation with temporary sessions, different from Amazon Cognito that especially provides authentication and authorization for end users application web/mobile.
keyNote: IAM Identity Center = centralized workforce access to many AWS accounts/applications; Cognito = identity for app users.

name: Amazon Cognito
generalExplanation: Amazon Cognito provides identity capabilities for web and mobile applications. User pools is user directory that handles sign-up, sign-in, tokens, and federation with social, OIDC, or SAML providers. Identity pools can exchanges authenticated or guest identities becomes temporary AWS credentials to access AWS services appropriate IAM roles. Cognito focuses on customer/application users, whereas IAM Identity Center focuses on workforce users who access AWS accounts and business applications.
keyNote: Cognito user pools = app sign-up/sign-in; identity pools = temporary AWS credentials for app users.

name: Multi-Account Governance
generalExplanation: AWS Organizations helps manages many AWS accounts in a manner centralized and Service Control Policies (SCPs) determines maximum available permissions for accounts or organizational units; SCPs not provides permissions. AWS Control Tower builds and meng-govern multi-account landing zone uses controls/guardrails. AWS Service Catalog provides catalog approved IT products so that users can perform self-service provisioning that remains controlled. AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) shares supported resources securely across accounts, organization, or OUs without having to create duplicate resource.
keyNote: Organizations/SCP = permission guardrails; Control Tower = governed landing zone; Service Catalog = approved products; RAM = resource sharing.

name: Credential Storage
generalExplanation: AWS Secrets Manager stores and manages secrets such as database credentials, API keys, and tokens and supports automatic rotation for many use case. AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store provides hierarchical storage for configuration data and can store encrypted SecureString values, but Parameter Store does not provide automatic rotation service itself. AWS KMS manages encryption keys; KMS is not the place primary to store password or API secret values.
keyNote: Secrets Manager = secret storage + rotation; Parameter Store = hierarchical config/secret values; KMS = encryption keys.

name: Encryption and Key Management
generalExplanation: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) is managed service to create and controls encryption/signing keys that integrated with many AWS services. AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated, single-tenant hardware security modules with control customer that larger over HSM and cryptographic keys. AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) creates, stores, and updates SSL/TLS X.509 certificates to protect websites and applications. So KMS focuses on managed key management, CloudHSM on dedicated HSM control, and ACM on certificate lifecycle.
keyNote: KMS = managed encryption keys; CloudHSM = dedicated HSM; ACM = SSL/TLS certificate management.

name: Security Groups
generalExplanation: Security groups is stateful virtual firewalls that controls inbound and outbound traffic on resources such as EC2 network interfaces. Security groups works on resource/instance level and only has allow rules; response traffic for allowed connection automatically allowed because nature stateful. Network ACLs works at the subnet level level, is stateless, and can have allow as well as deny rules.
keyNote: Security group = stateful, resource-level, allow rules; network ACL = stateless, subnet-level, allow/deny.

name: Network ACLs
generalExplanation: Network access control lists (network ACLs) is optional stateless controls at the subnet level that evaluates inbound and outbound traffic uses numbered allow and deny rules. Because stateless, return traffic must allowed explicitly by rules that appropriate. Network ACLs different from security groups that stateful, applied on resources/network interfaces, and uses allow rules.
keyNote: Network ACL = subnet-level, stateless, numbered allow/deny rules; return traffic evaluated separate.

name: AWS Shield
generalExplanation: AWS Shield provides protection against distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. Shield Standard provides basic DDoS protection automatically without subscription additional for AWS customers, whereas Shield Advanced is subscription with expanded DDoS detection, mitigation, visibility, and support capabilities for protected resources. AWS Shield different from AWS WAF: Shield focus on DDoS protection, whereas WAF checks and controls HTTP(S) web requests based on rules.
keyNote: Shield = DDoS protection; Standard included, Advanced subscription with protection and response capabilities broader.

name: AWS WAF and AWS Firewall Manager
generalExplanation: AWS WAF is web application firewall that uses protection packs (web ACLs) and rules for inspect and allow, block, or count HTTP(S) requests based on IP, country, strings, regex, rate, and attack patterns such as SQL injection or cross-site scripting. AWS Firewall Manager helps applies and manages firewall/security policies in a manner centralized in many accounts and resources. WAF different from Shield that focuses on DDoS protection and from security groups that controls network traffic on resource level.
keyNote: AWS WAF = filter HTTP(S) requests; Firewall Manager = centralized policy management across accounts/resources.

name: Amazon GuardDuty
generalExplanation: Amazon GuardDuty is threat detection service that continually analyzes AWS data sources and logs, threat intelligence, and machine learning for finds suspicious or malicious activity such as compromised credentials, unusual API behavior, cryptomining, and malware-related activity. GuardDuty produces security findings. GuardDuty different from Inspector that focuses on vulnerabilities/exposure, Macie that focuses on sensitive data in S3, and Detective that helps investigation findings.
keyNote: GuardDuty = continuous threat detection from AWS telemetry and threat intelligence; output mainly security findings.

name: Amazon Inspector
generalExplanation: Amazon Inspector is vulnerability management service that automatically finds workloads and continually scans Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon ECR container images, and AWS Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure that is supported. Inspector produces findings that helps prioritizes remediation. Different from GuardDuty that detects suspicious/malicious activity, Inspector especially searches vulnerabilities and exposure.
keyNote: Inspector = continuous vulnerability scanning for EC2, ECR container images, and Lambda; GuardDuty = threat detection.

name: Amazon Macie
generalExplanation: Amazon Macie is data security service that uses machine learning and pattern matching for finds sensitive data and provides visibility over data-security risks especially on Amazon S3. Macie can menginventarisasi S3 buckets, memonitor access/security posture, and runs sensitive data discovery for type data such as credentials, financial information, PHI, and PII. Macie different from GuardDuty that detects threats and Inspector that scans software vulnerabilities.
keyNote: Macie = discover and monitor sensitive data/security risks in Amazon S3.

name: Amazon Detective
generalExplanation: Amazon Detective helps security investigation and root-cause analysis with collects and connects data from AWS resources, then uses analytics and graph-based visualizations to grant context on findings and suspicious activity. Detective can help investigates GuardDuty and security findings. Detective is not service primary for produces vulnerability findings or sensitive-data discovery; perannya is investigation and context.
keyNote: Detective = investigate findings and suspicious activity with correlated context/behavior graph.

name: AWS Security Hub
generalExplanation: AWS Security Hub Cloud Security Posture Management (Security Hub CSPM) provides centralized view over security posture, collects findings from AWS services and supported third-party products, and assesses environment against security standards and best practices. Security Hub CSPM can receive findings from services such as GuardDuty, Inspector, and Macie and runs security controls that many depends on AWS Config. Security Hub aggregates and prioritizes security posture information; ia is not a substitute for threat-detection engine GuardDuty or vulnerability scanner Inspector.
keyNote: Security Hub CSPM = aggregate findings + security posture/standards; GuardDuty/Inspector/Macie produces specialized findings.

name: AWS CloudTrail
generalExplanation: AWS CloudTrail records activity in AWS account as events, including actions from console, CLI, SDKs, APIs, and AWS services. Event history provides searchable record 90 day for management events in Region, whereas trail that configured can send event to S3 for retention goes beyond jendela Event history. CloudTrail especially answers who performs what, when, and from which; CloudWatch focuses on operational telemetry such as metrics, logs, alarms, and observability. Notes per 10 November 2026: CloudTrail Lake not receives customer new since 31 Mei 2026. Customer that already meets requirement can remains using it. For requirements audit new, consider trail with delivery to S3 and retention that configured as needed.
keyNote: CloudTrail = audit/API activity history; CloudWatch = operational monitoring, metrics, logs, and alarms.

name: Amazon CloudWatch
generalExplanation: Amazon CloudWatch provides observability for AWS resources and applications through metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, traces, and monitoring capabilities. CloudWatch alarms can memantau metrics against thresholds and triggers notifications or automated actions. CloudWatch different from CloudTrail that records account/API activity for audit and from AWS Config that records resource configuration state and compliance.
keyNote: CloudWatch = metrics/logs/alarms/observability; CloudTrail = audit activity; Config = resource configuration/compliance.

name: AWS Config
generalExplanation: AWS Config records configuration state and relationships from supported AWS resources so that changes can reviewed throughout time. AWS Config rules evaluates resource configuration against desired conditions and menandai compliant or noncompliant resources. Config suitable for configuration history, audit, and continuous compliance. Different from CloudTrail that records API/account activity and CloudWatch that focuses on operational telemetry.
keyNote: AWS Config = resource configuration history + compliance evaluation; CloudTrail = API activity; CloudWatch = operational telemetry.

name: AWS Compliance and AWS Artifact
generalExplanation: AWS compliance programs and resources helps customers understands controls, certifications, and assurance information that relevant. AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security/compliance reports and legal agreements; through Artifact customers can mengunduh reports and review, accept, and manage agreements such as Business Associate Addendum if applicable. Artifact not scans resources for compliance and does not improve configuration; function that different from AWS Config or Security Hub CSPM.
keyNote: AWS Artifact = compliance reports and agreements; is not resource scanner or remediation service.

name: Security Resources and Third-Party Products
generalExplanation: AWS provides various security learning and support resources. AWS Security website/center and AWS Security Blog provides guidance, announcements, and best practices. AWS re:Post Knowledge Center contains official troubleshooting articles for common customer issues. AWS Marketplace provides third-party security software and services that can chosen and dibeli for use case such as application security, identity, monitoring, and managed security. Choose resource based on requirements: official guidance/troubleshooting different from procuring third-party products.
keyNote: Security Blog/website = AWS guidance; re:Post Knowledge Center = official troubleshooting; Marketplace = third-party security products/services.

name: Ways to Access AWS (Console, CLI, SDKs, APIs)
generalExplanation: AWS resources can managed through several interface. AWS Management Console provides interface based web for work interactive. AWS CLI runs command AWS from command shell and suitable for scripting. AWS SDK provides library that integrated with language pemrograman so that application can calls AWS APIs. AWS service APIs is interface programmatic that mendasari various tools that. Choice interface does not change permission: all request remains must diautentikasi and authorized.
keyNote: Console = web UI; CLI = command line/scripting; SDK = library within application; API = interface programmatic service.

name: Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation)
generalExplanation: Infrastructure as code (IaC) defines infrastructure within file so that resource can be created and changed in a manner repeatable. AWS CloudFormation uses template JSON or YAML for describes AWS resources and then men-deploy-nya as stack. Template can stored in version control, direview, used again, and helps reduces configuration drift consequence provisioning manual. CloudFormation different from Elastic Beanstalk: CloudFormation is general-purpose infrastructure provisioning, whereas Elastic Beanstalk focuses on deployment and management environment application.
keyNote: CloudFormation = definisikan AWS resources as template then manage deployment-nya as stack.

name: Cloud Deployment Models (cloud, hybrid, on-premises, Outposts)
generalExplanation: Cloud deployment uses resources that operates in cloud provider. On-premises runs infrastructure in facility organization itself. Hybrid connects environment on-premises with cloud so that both used shared. AWS Outposts is fully managed by AWS infrastructure that placed in customer premises and remains connected to AWS Region, so that suitable for hybrid workloads that requires local processing, low latency, or data residency specific.
keyNote: Cloud = resource in AWS; on-premises = resource in facility itself; hybrid = both connected; Outposts carries AWS infrastructure to customer premises.

name: AWS Regions
generalExplanation: AWS Region is geographic area separate that contains multiple Availability Zones. Selection Region typically considers compliance/data residency, proximity to user for latency, service availability, and cost. Resource does not automatically replicated to other Region except service or architecture indeed configured for doing so. Region different from Availability Zone: Region is geographic area, whereas AZ is isolated location within Region.
keyNote: Region = geographic area; choose based on compliance, latency, service availability, and cost.

name: Availability Zones
generalExplanation: Availability Zone (AZ) is isolated location within AWS Region and consists from one or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and connectivity. AZ within Region connected with low-latency, high-bandwidth, highly redundant networking. Distributes workload to several AZ helps increases availability because failure one location not must stops all workload. AZ is not Region rather than edge location.
keyNote: AZ = isolated location in a single Region; Multi-AZ helps protects workload from failure one location.

name: Edge Locations and AWS Global Accelerator
generalExplanation: AWS has global network of points of presence (PoPs), including edge locations, that is located closer to end users rather than many Regional workloads. PoPs used by services such as Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Route 53, and AWS Global Accelerator. Global Accelerator uses AWS global network and static anycast IP addresses to direct traffic to healthy Regional endpoints with path that optimal. Edge location different from Region: edge location is part from edge network, is not location primary to run general-purpose regional compute resources.
keyNote: Edge/PoP carries networking and content services closer to users; Global Accelerator optimizes traffic to healthy Regional endpoints.

name: Amazon EC2 and Instance Types
generalExplanation: Amazon EC2 provides virtual servers in AWS Cloud with control over operating system, software, networking, and compute configuration. Instance type determines combination compute, memory, storage, and networking resources. General purpose suitable for workloads seimbang; compute optimized for CPU-intensive workloads; memory optimized for workloads that requires memory large; accelerated computing for hardware accelerator such as GPU; storage optimized for workloads with requirements storage I/O high. EC2 gives control larger rather than serverless services such as Lambda, but customer also has more operational responsibility.
keyNote: EC2 = virtual server; choose instance family as needed compute, memory, accelerated computing, or storage.

name: Auto Scaling
generalExplanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling helps maintains number EC2 instances that appropriate for workloads. Auto Scaling group has minimum, maximum, and desired capacity; scaling policies can add instances when demand naik and menguranginya when demand decreases. Auto Scaling also can replace unhealthy instances for maintains desired capacity. Auto Scaling different from Elastic Load Balancing: Auto Scaling changes and maintains compute capacity, whereas ELB distributes incoming traffic to healthy targets.
keyNote: EC2 Auto Scaling = maintain and adjust number instances; ELB = distribute traffic to healthy targets.

name: Elastic Load Balancing
generalExplanation: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) distributes incoming traffic to multiple healthy targets such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses, including across multiple Availability Zones. Health checks helps routes traffic to healthy targets when available. ELB increases availability and helps prevents one target receives all traffic. ELB not adds number EC2 instances; capacity compute typically adjusted by EC2 Auto Scaling. Pernyataan healthy-target routing does not guarantee mutlak. For example, Application Load Balancer can fail open and remains sends request to target when all target within target group not healthy.
keyNote: ELB = one entry point that distributes traffic to healthy targets; Auto Scaling changes number compute.

name: AWS Lambda and Serverless APIs (API Gateway)
generalExplanation: AWS Lambda is serverless compute service to run code without provisioning or manages servers. Lambda Functions general used for event-driven and request-response workloads and scale automatically appropriate invocations. Amazon API Gateway used to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure REST, HTTP, or WebSocket APIs and can becomes front door for Lambda. Lambda different from EC2 because customer not manages underlying servers; EC2 gives control server that more directly.
keyNote: Lambda = run code without manage server; API Gateway = managed front door for APIs, including APIs that calls Lambda.

name: Containers (ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR)
generalExplanation: Amazon ECS is fully managed container orchestration AWS service. Amazon FORMER is managed Kubernetes service for workloads that requires Kubernetes APIs and ecosystem. AWS Fargate is serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine for containers so that customer does not need to manage server capacity for tasks/pods that is supported. Amazon ECR is managed container image registry to store, push, and pull container images. ECR stores images; ECS/FORMER meng-orchestrate containers; Fargate provides compute for menjalankannya.
keyNote: ECS = AWS container orchestration; FORMER = managed Kubernetes; Fargate = serverless container compute; ECR = image registry.

name: Managed Compute Options (Elastic Beanstalk, Lightsail, Batch)
generalExplanation: AWS Elastic Beanstalk helps deploy web applications with handles provisioning and configuration environment such as compute, load balancing, health monitoring, and scaling based on platform that chosen. Amazon Lightsail simplifies virtual private servers and resource general for website or small applications with experience that more simple and predictable bundles. AWS Batch is fully managed service for scheduling and runs batch computing jobs and provisioning compute appropriate job demand. Ketiganya solves use case different and does not replace general-purpose IaC such as CloudFormation.
keyNote: Beanstalk = managed app environment; Lightsail = simple VPS/application bundle; Batch = managed batch-job scheduling and compute.

name: Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora (managed vs EC2-hosted databases)
generalExplanation: Amazon RDS is managed relational database service that handles many database administration tasks such as backups, software patching, failure detection, and recovery. Amazon Aurora is fully managed relational database engine that compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL. RDS Multi-AZ especially used for high availability and failover, whereas read replicas general used to improve read scaling. Runs database itself in EC2 gives control larger against OS and database stack, but customer also manages more operation.
keyNote: RDS/Aurora = managed relational databases; Multi-AZ for availability/failover, read replicas for read scaling.

name: Amazon DynamoDB
generalExplanation: Amazon DynamoDB is serverless, fully managed, distributed NoSQL database that supports key-value and document data models and designed for consistent single-digit millisecond performance at scale. Customer not manages database servers or patching. DynamoDB suitable for high-scale operational workloads with access patterns that can dimodelkan through keys and indexes. DynamoDB different from RDS: DynamoDB is NoSQL, whereas RDS is managed relational database with relational engines and SQL capabilities.
keyNote: DynamoDB = serverless managed NoSQL key-value/document database with low-latency performance at scale.

name: Other Purpose-Built Databases (ElastiCache, DocumentDB, Neptune)
generalExplanation: AWS provides purpose-built database services for requirements different. Amazon ElastiCache provides distributed in-memory data store/cache for low-latency access and supports Valkey, Memcached, and Redis OSS. Amazon DocumentDB is fully managed document database with MongoDB compatibility. Amazon Neptune is fully managed graph database for highly connected datasets such as relationship graphs, recommendation, and fraud use cases. Choose database based on data model and access pattern, is more than just because all service stores data.
keyNote: ElastiCache = in-memory cache; DocumentDB = MongoDB-compatible document database; Neptune = graph database.

name: Database Migration (AWS DMS, AWS SCT)
generalExplanation: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) used for migrate or replicate data between supported data stores and can support one-time migration as well as ongoing changes to reduce downtime. For migration between different database engines, schema may need to converted. DMS Schema Conversion can perform assessment and conversion, and AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) also can be used for convert existing database schema from one engine to engine other. DMS focuses on data movement/replication; schema-conversion tools focuses on database schema and code objects.
keyNote: DMS = move/replicate data; DMS Schema Conversion or AWS SCT = convert schema when target engine different.

name: Amazon VPC (subnets, gateways, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway)
generalExplanation: Amazon VPC provides logically isolated virtual network in AWS. Subnet is range IP addresses within VPC and is located in one Availability Zone. Route tables determines direction network traffic. Internet gateway connects VPC to internet for resource that designed has internet connectivity, whereas NAT gateway general used so that resources in private subnet can start outbound IPv4 connections without receives unsolicited inbound connections from internet. VPC endpoints/AWS PrivateLink gives private connectivity to supported services without through public internet. AWS Transit Gateway acts as central hub to connect multiple VPCs and on-premises networks.
keyNote: VPC = isolated virtual network; subnet = AZ-scoped IP range; endpoints/PrivateLink = private service access; Transit Gateway = central network hub.

name: Amazon Route 53
generalExplanation: Amazon Route 53 is highly available and scalable DNS service. Route 53 can mendaftarkan domain names, meng-host DNS records that menerjemahkan names to endpoints, performs health checks, and uses routing policies for determines answer DNS. Route 53 different from Elastic Load Balancing: Route 53 provides DNS-level routing/lookup, whereas ELB receives and distributes application/network traffic to registered targets.
keyNote: Route 53 = DNS, domain registration, health checks, and DNS routing; ELB = distribute traffic to targets.

name: Amazon CloudFront
generalExplanation: Amazon CloudFront is content delivery network (CDN) that accelerates delivery static and dynamic web content through global network of edge locations. CloudFront stores cacheable content closer to users and takes content from origin such as Amazon S3 bucket or HTTP server when required. CloudFront different from AWS Global Accelerator: CloudFront focuses on content delivery/caching in edge, whereas Global Accelerator optimizes network path to healthy regional application endpoints uses static anycast IP addresses.
keyNote: CloudFront = CDN that deliver and cache content through edge locations for latency lower.

name: Hybrid Connectivity (AWS VPN, AWS Direct Connect)
generalExplanation: AWS Site-to-Site VPN connects on-premises network with Amazon VPC uses encrypted IPsec tunnels, typically through internet. AWS Direct Connect provides dedicated network connection from customer network to AWS so that can give more consistent network performance and avoids internet service providers on network path. VPN typically faster disiapkan and suitable for encrypted connectivity, temporary connectivity, or backup; Direct Connect suitable when workload requires dedicated, higher-bandwidth, more consistent connectivity. Both can be used shared appropriate availability and encryption requirements.
keyNote: Site-to-Site VPN = encrypted IPsec connectivity; Direct Connect = dedicated private network path to AWS.

name: Amazon S3
generalExplanation: Amazon S3 is highly scalable object storage service. Data stored as objects within buckets and can be used for backup, data lakes, static content, media, archives, analytics, and many use other case. S3 is not block storage or shared POSIX file system. S3 provides feature such as versioning, replication, access controls, lifecycle management, and multiple storage classes. Choose S3 when the application requires durable object storage that accessed through S3 APIs, is not attached block device such as EBS.
keyNote: S3 = scalable object storage; bucket contains objects and metadata, is not block device or traditional shared file system.

name: Amazon S3 Storage Classes and Lifecycle Policies
generalExplanation: S3 provides storage classes for access patterns different. S3 Standard suitable for frequently accessed data; S3 Intelligent-Tiering can move objects across access tiers when pattern not known or changes; S3 Standard-IA for long-lived infrequently accessed data that still requires millisecond access; S3 One Zone-IA stores data in a single Availability Zone; S3 Glacier classes intended for archive with retrieval characteristics different. S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to storage class other or expire/delete objects based on rules time and filter.
keyNote: Choose S3 storage class based on access pattern; Lifecycle mengotomatisasi transition and expiration objects.

name: Block Storage (Amazon EBS, Instance Store)
generalExplanation: Amazon EBS provides persistent block storage volumes for EC2 instances. EBS volume has lifecycle that separate from host hardware and can be used for data that must persists goes beyond stop/start or replacement instance appropriate configuration. EC2 instance store provides temporary block storage that physically attached to host; the data can lost when underlying instance is stopped, hibernated, terminated, or host fails. Instance store suitable for temporary buffers, caches, scratch data, or replicated data that can be created again. When instance stopped permanent (terminated), EBS does not always retained: perilakunya determined by DeleteOnTermination for each volume. Persistent storage is not a substitute for backup.
keyNote: EBS = persistent EC2 block storage; instance store = ephemeral host-attached storage for temporary/re-creatable data.

name: File Storage (Amazon EFS, Amazon FSx)
generalExplanation: Amazon EFS provides serverless, elastic shared file storage with NFS interface for Linux-based workloads and can accessed concurrently by multiple clients. Amazon FSx provides fully managed file systems for specific file-system technologies and workloads, such as Windows File Server, Lustre, NetApp ONTAP, and OpenZFS. EFS suitable when workload requires shared NFS file system that elastic; FSx suitable when workload requires capabilities or compatibility from supported specialized file systems.
keyNote: EFS = elastic shared NFS file storage; FSx = managed specialized file systems such as Windows, Lustre, ONTAP, and OpenZFS.

name: AWS Storage Gateway
generalExplanation: AWS Storage Gateway connects on-premises applications with cloud-backed AWS storage through gateway appliance. S3 File Gateway exposes file interface such as NFS/SMB and stores data as objects in Amazon S3. Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed iSCSI block volumes. Tape Gateway provides virtual tape library for backup workflows and archive in S3 Glacier storage classes. Storage Gateway different from Direct Connect or VPN: gateway provides hybrid storage integration, whereas Direct Connect/VPN provides network connectivity.
keyNote: Storage Gateway = hybrid storage bridge; S3 File Gateway=file, Volume Gateway=block, Tape Gateway=virtual tapes.

name: AWS Backup and AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery
generalExplanation: AWS Backup is centralized service for mengotomatisasi and manages data protection policies and backups across supported AWS services and environments. AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) focuses on disaster recovery for servers/workloads with continuous block-level replication to staging area and recovery/cutover when required. Backup especially protects recoverable copies of data, whereas DRS helps restores entire server workloads with recovery objectives that faster.
keyNote: AWS Backup = centralized backup policies/copies; AWS DRS = replicate servers for disaster recovery and recovery launch.

name: Amazon SageMaker AI
generalExplanation: Amazon SageMaker AI is fully managed service to build, melatih, and deploy machine learning models and supports ML lifecycle tooling. SageMaker AI suitable when teams needs to mengembangkan custom ML models and manages training/inference workflows. This different from pre-trained AI services such as Comprehend, Rekognition, Textract, Polly, or Translate, that provides ready-to-use capabilities through APIs without requires customer builds model from initial.
keyNote: SageMaker AI = build, train, and deploy custom ML models; AI other services gives pre-built capabilities.

name: AI Language and Assistant Services (Comprehend, Lex, Polly, Transcribe, Translate, Amazon Q)
generalExplanation: AWS provides managed AI services for language and assistants. Amazon Comprehend extracts insights from text uses NLP. Amazon Lex builds conversational interfaces/chatbots based voice and text. Amazon Polly changes text becomes lifelike speech, Amazon Transcribe changes speech becomes text, and Amazon Translate performs neural machine translation. Amazon Q is family of generative AI assistants; Amazon Q Developer helps development and operation AWS, whereas enterprise assistant capabilities berkembang to Amazon Quick for workplace use cases. Choose service based on input/output that is required.
keyNote: Comprehend=text insights; Lex=chatbot; Polly=text-to-speech; Transcribe=speech-to-text; Translate=translation; Q=generative AI assistant.

name: AI Vision and Document Services (Rekognition, Textract)
generalExplanation: Amazon Rekognition analyzes images and videos for capabilities such as object, scene, text, face, and unsafe-content detection appropriate feature that used. Amazon Textract extracts printed/handwritten text, forms, tables, and structured data from documents. Rekognition focuses on visual analysis, whereas Textract focuses on document text and structure extraction.
keyNote: Rekognition = image/video analysis; Textract = extract text, forms, tables, and document structure.

name: Analytics Services (Athena, Redshift, EMR, Glue)
generalExplanation: Amazon Athena is serverless interactive query service for analyzes data in Amazon S3 uses SQL. Amazon Redshift is managed cloud data warehouse for analytics at scale. Amazon EMR provides managed big-data platforms for frameworks such as Apache Spark and Hadoop. AWS Glue is serverless data integration service for discover, prepare, move, and integrate data, including catalog and ETL capabilities. Choose Athena for ad hoc SQL directly on S3, Redshift for data warehousing, EMR for big-data frameworks, and Glue for data integration/catalog/ETL.
keyNote: Athena=serverless SQL on S3; Redshift=data warehouse; EMR=big-data frameworks; Glue=data integration/catalog/ETL.

name: Streaming, Search, and BI (Kinesis, OpenSearch Service, Amazon Quick Sight)
generalExplanation: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams used for collect and process real-time streaming data. Amazon OpenSearch Service is managed service for search, log analytics, observability, and related use cases uses OpenSearch. Amazon Quick Sight is BI capability within Amazon Quick, evolusi from Amazon QuickSight, for interactive visualizations, dashboards, and analytics. Kinesis handles streaming ingestion, OpenSearch handles search/log analytics, and Quick Sight presents business intelligence visualizations. On Kinesis Data Streams, order sequence number applies within shard, does not guarantee one order global for all shard.
keyNote: Kinesis=real-time streams; OpenSearch=search/log analytics; Amazon Quick Sight=BI dashboards and visualizations.

name: Application Integration (SNS, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions)
generalExplanation: Amazon SNS is pub/sub messaging service that fan-out messages to multiple subscribers/endpoints. Amazon SQS is managed message queue for decoupling producers and consumers; messages waits until processed or expired. Amazon EventBridge is event bus/router for event-driven applications and routing events based on rules. AWS Step Functions orchestrates multi-step workflows as state machines. SNS pushes to subscribers, SQS queues work, EventBridge routes events, and Step Functions coordinates workflow steps.
keyNote: SNS=pub/sub fan-out; SQS=queue; EventBridge=event routing; Step Functions=workflow orchestration.

name: AWS Systems Manager
generalExplanation: AWS Systems Manager helps centrally view, manage, and operate managed nodes in AWS, on-premises, and multicloud. Capabilities such as Run Command runs commands remotely, Session Manager gives secure interactive access without opens inbound SSH/RDP ports, Automation runs operational runbooks, and Patch Manager helps patching at scale. Parameter Store can store configuration data and secrets simple. Systems Manager different from CloudWatch: Systems Manager performs management/operations actions, whereas CloudWatch especially monitoring, metrics, logs, and alarms.
keyNote: Systems Manager = centralized node operations: command, session, automation, patching, configuration.

name: Developer Tools (CodeBuild, CodePipeline, X-Ray)
generalExplanation: AWS CodeBuild is fully managed build service that compile source code, run tests, and produces build artifacts. AWS CodePipeline is continuous delivery service that orchestrates stages within software release pipeline. AWS X-Ray helps developers analyze and debug distributed applications with tracing request paths, latency, and service dependencies. CodeBuild runs build/test work, CodePipeline manages release workflow, and X-Ray provides distributed tracing/diagnostics.
keyNote: CodeBuild=build/test; CodePipeline=release workflow orchestration; X-Ray=distributed tracing and debugging.

name: End-User Computing (WorkSpaces, WorkSpaces Applications / AppStream 2.0, WorkSpaces Secure Browser)
generalExplanation: Amazon WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops managed. WorkSpaces Personal provides desktop persistent that dialokasikan to user, whereas WorkSpaces Pools provides desktop non-persisten. Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (previously Amazon AppStream 2.0) performs streaming application without installation local. WorkSpaces Secure Browser is service hosted browser specific for access web terisolasi. Since 29 Oktober 2026, Secure Browser not receives customer new; customer long can continues penggunaannya. For requirements new, WorkSpaces Applications with image browser that managed itself is one of alternative that documented AWS.
keyNote: WorkSpaces=virtual desktop; WorkSpaces Applications (formerly AppStream 2.0)=application streaming; Secure Browser=isolated browser access.

name: Business, Frontend, and IoT Services (Connect, SES, Amplify, IoT Core)
generalExplanation: Amazon Connect is cloud contact center service. Amazon SES is email service for sending and receiving use cases. AWS Amplify provides tools and managed capabilities for building, hosting, and deploying web/mobile frontends and full-stack applications. AWS IoT Core connects IoT devices to AWS uses supported messaging protocols and rules so device data can processed or diarahkan to AWS services. Keempat service handles use case that different: contact center, email, application frontend, and IoT connectivity.
keyNote: Connect=contact center; SES=email; Amplify=web/mobile app platform/hosting; IoT Core=device connectivity and messaging.

name: On-Demand and Spot Instances
generalExplanation: Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances uses pay-as-you-go pricing without long-term commitment and suitable for workloads that cannot predicted, short-term, or not tolerant against interruption. Spot Instances uses spare EC2 capacity with discount large compared On-Demand, but can interrupted by EC2 when capacity required back. Spot suitable for fault-tolerant, flexible, stateless, batch, or distributed workloads that can handle interruption. For steady usage with commitment, Savings Plans or Reserved Instances typically more relevant.
keyNote: On-Demand = flexible without commitment; Spot = spare capacity with discount large but can interrupted.

name: Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Capacity Reservations
generalExplanation: Savings Plans provides discount as imbalan over commitment against consistent usage within USD per hour while 1 or 3 year. Reserved Instances provides billing discount for commitment against instance configuration specific while 1 or 3 year. Capacity Reservations different: destination mainly is ensures EC2 capacity available for configuration specific in Availability Zone and can dikenakan cost equivalent On-Demand although capacity not used. Capacity guarantee and billing discount is two konsep different; Savings Plans or eligible RI discounts can applied on matching Capacity Reservation usage.
keyNote: Savings Plans/RI = pricing discounts with commitment; Capacity Reservation = reserve EC2 capacity, does not automatically discount.

name: Dedicated Hosts and Dedicated Instances
generalExplanation: Dedicated Instances is EC2 instances that operates on single-tenant hardware dedicated for one customer account, but customer not gets visibility/control over physical host placement that the same as Dedicated Hosts. Dedicated Hosts provides physical server that didedikasikan for customer and enables visibility and control over sockets/cores and instance placement that important for several software licensing and compliance scenarios. Both different from standard shared-tenancy EC2.
keyNote: Dedicated Host = dedicated physical server + host-level visibility/control; Dedicated Instance = instance on single-tenant hardware without host-level control that same.

name: Data Transfer Costs
generalExplanation: AWS data transfer pricing depends on service, source/destination, Region, Availability Zone, and direction. Data transfer into AWS from internet often not subject to data-transfer charge, whereas data transfer out to internet generally subject to charge after applicable free allowance. Several transfers across Availability Zones within Region can subject to charge, temporary transfers specific within Availability Zone or between supported AWS services within Region can gratis. For question exam, avoid memorizes price number; understand direction and topology that affects cost.
keyNote: Data-transfer cost depends on direction and topology; outbound/cross-AZ often more expensive rather than inbound/same-AZ.

name: Cost Management Tools (Budgets, Cost Explorer, Pricing Calculator, Cost and Usage Report)
generalExplanation: AWS Cost Explorer used to view, filters, and analyzes historical cost/usage and forecasts. AWS Budgets sets cost/usage targets and alerts when actual or forecasted values exceeds threshold. AWS Pricing Calculator creates estimates for planned workloads or modeled billing changes before deployment/change performed. AWS Data Exports with Cost and Usage Report 2.0 (CUR 2.0) provides detailed cost and usage data for downstream analysis. Choose tool based on whether requirements mainly analysis, alerting, estimation, or detailed export.
keyNote: Cost Explorer=analyze; Budgets=threshold/alert; Pricing Calculator=estimate; CUR 2.0/Data Exports=detailed billing data.

name: AWS Organizations Consolidated Billing
generalExplanation: AWS Organizations consolidated billing combines charges from member accounts to management account so that organization gets central bill and consolidated cost visibility. Usage from multiple accounts can digabung for applicable volume pricing tiers, and eligible Reserved Instance or Savings Plans benefits can shared appropriate billing rules. Consolidated billing not combines security boundaries: member accounts remains separate AWS accounts. AWS Organizations consolidated billing not subject to additional fee.
keyNote: Consolidated billing = one combined bill + aggregated usage benefits; accounts remains separate.

name: Cost Allocation Tags
generalExplanation: Tags is key-value metadata on AWS resources. To use tags within billing analysis, relevant AWS-generated or user-defined tags must enabled as cost allocation tags. After active, tag can help groups, filters, and allocates cost based on business context such as project, application, environment, or cost center. Cost allocation tags helps showback/chargeback and reporting, but does not change price resource that itself.
keyNote: Cost allocation tags = enable tags for groups and tracks cost based on business context.

name: AWS Support Plans
generalExplanation: Current AWS Support lineup includes Basic Support, AWS Business Support+, AWS Enterprise Support, and AWS Unified Operations. Basic available for all customers and includes account/billing support, service health, documentation, and service quota increase requests, but is not technical support cases. Business Support+ adds 24/7 technical support and full Trusted Advisor checks. Enterprise Support adds designated Technical Account Manager (TAM), faster critical response, and strategic guidance. Unified Operations is tier most proactive with designated specialist team, workload monitoring, deep operational guidance, and rapid incident engagement. Developer Support, Business Support, and Enterprise On-Ramp still transitional until end-of-support on 1 January 2027 rather than target lineup primary bank this. Notes per 10 November 2026: transition package and ketersediaannya can different according to Region. Developer Support, Business Support, and Enterprise On-Ramp remains available in AWS GovCloud (US). Target initial response measures tanggapan initial based on severity, does not guarantee time completion incident.
keyNote: Basic < Business Support+ < Enterprise Support < Unified Operations; capability and proactive guidance increases in tier higher.

name: AWS Trusted Advisor (including Service Quotas)
generalExplanation: AWS Trusted Advisor checks AWS environment and gives recommendations within categories such as Cost Optimization, Performance, Security, Fault Tolerance, Service Limits, and Operational Excellence. Trusted Advisor is not real-time monitoring system such as CloudWatch rather than account-specific service event feed such as AWS Health. Service-limit checks helps identifies usage that mendekati quota; quota increase typically managed through Service Quotas or Support appropriate service. Access to full set of Trusted Advisor checks depends on support plan.
keyNote: Trusted Advisor = best-practice recommendations; Service Quotas = manage/request service quota increases.

name: AWS Health Dashboard and AWS Health API
generalExplanation: AWS Health Dashboard displays public service events and, when signed in, account-specific events and scheduled changes that can affects resources. Public service-health events not specific to account; account-specific events can mentions affected resources and recommended actions. AWS Health API enables programmatic access to health information but requires eligible paid support plan such as Business Support+, Enterprise Support, or Unified Operations. AWS Health different from Trusted Advisor: Health focuses on AWS service/account events, whereas Trusted Advisor provides best-practice recommendations. Package legacy specific also still can meet requirement API while transition or in Region that not offers lineup new. Eligibility must dicek on documentation AWS Health API, is not disimpulkan from term paid support only.
keyNote: AWS Health = service/account events and scheduled changes; Trusted Advisor = recommendations against environment.

name: AWS Technical Resources (documentation, whitepapers, re:Post, Knowledge Center, Prescriptive Guidance, Support Center, Trust and Safety)
generalExplanation: AWS provides resource different as needed. AWS Documentation is product/service reference and user guides. AWS Whitepapers discusses architecture, security, economics, and best practices in a manner broader. AWS re:Post is community knowledge service and becomes home for AWS Knowledge Center articles that contains troubleshooting guidance. AWS Prescriptive Guidance provides patterns, strategies, and implementation guidance for common cloud initiatives. AWS Support Center used for support cases for account that eligible. Trust & Safety handles abuse and safety-related reports appropriate process AWS.
keyNote: Docs=product reference; re:Post/Knowledge Center=Q&A + troubleshooting; Prescriptive Guidance=patterns/strategies; Support Center=support cases.

name: AWS Partners, Marketplace, Professional Services, and Solutions Architects
generalExplanation: AWS Marketplace is curated digital catalog for finds, buys, deploy, and manage third-party software, data, and services, including professional services offerings. AWS Partner Network (APN) is global community of organizations that builds and provides solutions/services uses AWS. AWS Professional Services provides AWS-led consulting engagements for initiatives such as migration, modernization, data/AI, and operational transformation. AWS Solutions Architects provides technical guidance to help customers designs solutions; they is not product catalog or support-plan replacement.
keyNote: Marketplace=buy third-party offerings; APN=partner ecosystem; Professional Services=AWS consulting; Solutions Architects=technical architecture guidance.
